At The Trustee for DEREK MCKERCHER FAMILY TRUST t/a PSW Energy, we are looking for a full time (at least 38 hours per week) skilled Technical Sales Representatives nec to perform the following duties:

•	Building and maintaining a pipeline of prospective residential and commercial clients across Western Australia interested in solar, battery storage, and EV charging solutions, using company databases, referrals, and industry contacts. 
•	Holding extensive technical knowledge of current solar panel, battery storage and EV charging products.
•	Review, specify and design residential and commercial renewable energy systems.
•	Maintaining knowledge and understanding of product offerings, competitor offerings, and WA market conditions.
•	Conducting site visits and client consultations to identify opportunities for solar, battery, and EV charging installations, and to progress these into confirmed sales. 
•	Assessing each client's energy usage and property requirements, then recommending and explaining suitable itemised solar, battery, or EV charging packages tailored to their needs. 
•	Tracking shifts in customer requirements and competitor activity within the renewable energy market, and reporting relevant trends and insights to management. 
•	Preparing and negotiating quotations, pricing, and payment terms for solar, battery, and EV charging packages, and finalising contracts and purchase orders with clients. 
•	Coordinating with internal installation and technical teams to arrange delivery of equipment, scheduling of installations, and provision of PSW Tech Support services. 
•	Reporting to management on completed sales and the market performance of solar, battery, and EV charging products. 
•	Following up with clients post-installation to confirm satisfaction with their system and PSW Tech Support experience, resolving any technical or service issues raised. 
•	Preparing sales activity reports and maintaining records of client interactions and business expenses incurred in the course of sales activities.

•	The right candidate will have at least 3 years of proven experience within the renewable energy sector.
•	Professional approach.
•	Ability to work under pressure.

•	Excellent attention to detail.
•	Confident manner.
